prompt: A cinematic film still captures a bustling snowy town square at twilight. On the far left, an old stone fountain stands frozen in time, its spout capped with ice. Next to the fountain, a child in a yellow coat sits on the rim, dangling bare feet above the snow. A brown dog stands beside the child, looking up expectantly at a sausage held by a baker in a white apron who leans forward from the center of the frame. The baker points toward the right side of the square with his free hand, directing attention to a streetlamp glowing warmly against the blue dusk. Under that streetlamp, a woman in a green coat walks past, her scarf trailing behind her in the wind. She is handing a wrapped gift to a man in a black hat who waits patiently near a wooden bench. Sitting on that bench is an elderly person in a gray shawl, watching the exchange with a gentle smile. Behind them, a horse-drawn carriage waits, the horse stamping its hoof impatiently on the cobblestones. The driver, wearing a fur cap, looks back at a couple standing near the carriage wheel. The man in the couple wears a blue jacket and holds an umbrella over the woman in a pink dress, shielding her from falling snowflakes. In the background, a clock tower rises above the rooftops, its face illuminated softly. There is no modern vehicle visible in the scene. There is no sunlight breaking through the clouds.
